title: Readable attachment read failures are silently omitted from the outgoing context
reasoning: When read_file fails or returns no usable content, the helper logs a warning and returns null. The caller then filters null sections and sends the remaining attachment context, or no context at all if every read failed. That means a user can send a message with selected readable files but the model receives an incomplete or empty attachment context without any failure being surfaced to the send flow. This is especially risky for multi-file prompts where the model may answer as if all attachments were considered.
recommendation: Return structured success/failure information from attachment context building, and make the send flow block or surface a user-visible error when any requested readable attachment cannot be read. If partial send is intentional, include an explicit omitted-attachment notice in the model-visible context and UI state.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature metadata lists no linked tests, and the included package scripts only show generic Jest commands rather than focused coverage for partial readable-file failures.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test for buildReadableFileAttachmentContext with two readable files where one read_file invocation fails; assert the caller receives a failure/omission signal instead of silently producing context for only the successful file.
minimumFixScope: Change readableFileAttachmentContext to preserve per-file read status and update its immediate caller to handle failed attachments explicitly.
